name: MonarchBulkActionBar
title: BulkActionBar
summary: The bar shown while items are selected: the count, the actions for the selection with a More menu for the rest, and Clear selection, with the count announced.
whenToUse: Under or over a list or table with multiple selection, while at least one item is selected: archive, export, tag or delete the selection.
whenNotToUse: For actions on one item, use a row actions menu. For actions that do not depend on a selection, use the screen's top app bar.
api: @Composable fun MonarchBulkActionBar(count: Int, onClear: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, totalCount: Int? = null, actions: List<MonarchBulkAction> = emptyList(), maxVisibleActions: Int = 3, busy: Boolean = false, busyActionId: String? = null, labels: MonarchBulkActionBarLabels = MonarchBulkActionBarLabels(), accessories: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchBulkAction(id: String, title: String, destructive: Boolean = false, enabled: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onClick: () -> Unit)
class MonarchBulkActionBarLabels(selected: ((count: Int, total: Int?) -> String)? = null, cleared: String? = null, clear: String? = null, more: String? = null, bar: String? = null)

options.name: count
options.description: The number of selected items. The bar is shown while it is above 0 and takes no room at 0.

options.name: totalCount
options.description: The number of items that could be selected, for "3 of 120 selected".

options.name: actions
options.description: The actions. A destructive one uses the danger button variant and the strong danger color in the menu.

options.name: maxVisibleActions
options.description: How many actions are buttons; the rest go into a More menu. A negative value counts as 0.

options.name: busy
options.description: Blocks every action, More and Clear selection while the app runs one.

options.name: busyActionId
options.description: The running action shows a progress indicator and is announced as Loading; the other actions, More and Clear selection are disabled.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the count, the Clear selection and More labels, the cleared announcement and the bar's TalkBack name.

options.name: accessories
options.description: Extra controls after the actions, such as a picker for a property.

states.name: closed
states.description: Nothing is selected: nothing is drawn and the bar takes no room; only an empty live region stays.

states.name: open
states.description: The count, the action buttons, More and Clear selection on a raised surface.

states.name: busy
states.description: With busyActionId the action shows progress and the others are disabled; with busy every control is disabled.

states.name: narrow
states.description: When one line does not fit, the controls wrap onto further lines in reading order.

appearance: A raised surface (the raised background role) with the large radius, a subtle border and a small shadow. The count is label text in the default text role; actions are small secondary MonarchButtons, destructive ones the danger variant, and Clear selection a ghost button. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The parity map named a contextual TopAppBar or BottomAppBar. Both have a fixed height that cuts the count and the actions at large font sizes and hold only icons well, so the bar is a raised Surface with a FlowRow of MonarchButtons that the app places as the bottomBar of a Scaffold or inline above a list. The web toolbar has one tab stop with arrow keys; on Android each control is its own TalkBack element and keyboard stop. The web can wait on a promise returned by an action; here the app sets busyActionId or busy. The web placement option (sticky) is the app's placement. Confirmation of destructive actions stays in the app (AlertDialog). iOS uses the same name; isDestructive and isDisabled are destructive and enabled on Android, following Compose naming, and the icon is a slot because Monarch bundles no icons.
accessibility: The controls are a traversal group named "Bulk actions"; the count is read first, then each action, More and Clear selection.
Every change of the count is announced through a polite live region ("2 of 4 selected"), including when the bar first appears, and "Selection cleared" when the count returns to 0.
Icons are decorative; every action has a visible title.
Every button has a 48dp touch target; the running action is announced as Loading through MonarchButton, and blocked controls are announced as disabled.
edgeCases: maxVisibleActions of 0 puts every action in the More menu; a negative value counts as 0.
An action that empties the selection closes the bar and announces "Selection cleared".
The count uses plurals in strings_bulkactionbar.xml; pass labels.selected to write it differently.

examples.title: With DataTable selection
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
    MonarchBulkActionBar(
        count = selected.size,
        onClear = { selected = emptySet() },
        totalCount = members.size,
        actions = listOf(
            MonarchBulkAction(id = {{actions.0.id}}, title = {{actions.0.label}}) {},
            MonarchBulkAction(id = {{actions.1.id}}, title = {{actions.1.label}}) {},
            MonarchBulkAction(id = {{actions.2.id}}, title = {{actions.2.label}}) {},
            MonarchBulkAction(id = {{actions.3.id}}, title = {{actions.3.label}}, destructive = {{actions.3.destructive}}) {},
        ),
    )
    MonarchDataTable(
        caption = {{caption}},
        rows = members,
        columns = columns,
        rowKey = { it[0] },
        selection = selected,
        onSelectionChange = { selected = it },
        rowLabel = { it[1] },
    )
}
examples.setupTemplate:
val members = listOf(
    listOf({{members.0.id}}, {{members.0.name}}, {{members.0.team}}, {{members.0.role}}),
    listOf({{members.1.id}}, {{members.1.name}}, {{members.1.team}}, {{members.1.role}}),
    listOf({{members.2.id}}, {{members.2.name}}, {{members.2.team}}, {{members.2.role}}),
    listOf({{members.3.id}}, {{members.3.name}}, {{members.3.team}}, {{members.3.role}}),
)
val columns = listOf<MonarchDataTableColumn<List<String>>>(
    MonarchDataTableColumn({{columns.0}}, id = "name", hideable = false) { it[1] },
    MonarchDataTableColumn({{columns.1}}, id = "team", hideable = false) { it[2] },
    MonarchDataTableColumn({{columns.2}}, id = "role", hideable = false) { it[3] },
)
var selected by remember { mutableStateOf(setOf({{selected.0}}, {{selected.1}})) }
examples.setup:
val members = listOf(
    listOf("m1", "Ana Silva", "Support", "Agent"),
    listOf("m2", "Ben Okafor", "Support", "Lead"),
    listOf("m3", "Chen Wei", "Billing", "Agent"),
    listOf("m4", "Dev Patel", "Sales", "Manager"),
)
val columns = listOf<MonarchDataTableColumn<List<String>>>(
    MonarchDataTableColumn("Name", id = "name", hideable = false) { it[1] },
    MonarchDataTableColumn("Team", id = "team", hideable = false) { it[2] },
    MonarchDataTableColumn("Role", id = "role", hideable = false) { it[3] },
)
var selected by remember { mutableStateOf(setOf("m1", "m3")) }
examples.code:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
    MonarchBulkActionBar(
        count = selected.size,
        onClear = { selected = emptySet() },
        totalCount = members.size,
        actions = listOf(
            MonarchBulkAction(id = "team", title = "Move to team") {},
            MonarchBulkAction(id = "role", title = "Change role") {},
            MonarchBulkAction(id = "export", title = "Export") {},
            MonarchBulkAction(id = "remove", title = "Remove", destructive = true) {},
        ),
    )
    MonarchDataTable(
        caption = "Members",
        rows = members,
        columns = columns,
        rowKey = { it[0] },
        selection = selected,
        onSelectionChange = { selected = it },
        rowLabel = { it[1] },
    )
}
